rule.title: Integration Tests with Real Database State Rollback
rule.statement: Integration tests must execute against a real PostgreSQL instance with pgvector enabled, rolling back transactions after each test to ensure state cleanliness.
rule.rationale: In-memory fake databases (SQLite, Mock Prisma) do not support pgvector syntax, JSON operators, or PostgreSQL-specific constraint violations, masking critical production bugs.
rule.implementation_guidance: Use a dedicated test container or test database. Wrap tests in a rollback transaction or run truncate migrations in beforeEach.

forbidden.example: Mocking the entire PrismaClient object in an integration test.

preferred.example: await prisma.document.create(...); const res = await request(app).get('/api/v1/documents'); expect(res.status).toBe(200);

source.book_title: Unit Testing Principles, Practices, and Patterns
source.evidence_quote: Do not mock the database in integration tests. An integration test that uses a mock database is not an integration test; verify queries against a real instance.
